'''Revelation Hey, let's go Rescue The Princess!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 RTP Revelation LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I believe I have tweaked this deck to expert level. Tell me, will ya?

The published list has 73 cards.

== Strategy ==

Okay, rescue Leia, flip the objective, and win. Okay, okay, so it's simple, but it works!  Cam Solusar: Like I said elsewhere, I'm getting more starships soon. Basically for this deck I just went through my Profit and took out all the cards related to the old objective. Then I tweaked. I tweaked and I tweaked and then I tweaked some more.
